description: Browse Rebecca Belle Boutique products with stable IDs, names, prices, photos, availability and descriptive details. Supply store=women, men, kids, home, or accessories to browse a live collection with query, size, brand, category, min_price, max_price, nwt, sort, page, and page_size. Home offers home goods. Accessories offers shoes, jewelry and accessories. Product IDs use rb-#####, mm-#####, lc-#####, rh-#####, and rs-#####; cross-listed accessories retain their original product IDs and shared stock. The collections share a cart with $8 shipping per whole order and card payment through the boutique checkout. Collection and product records expose agent_purchase_enabled. Omit store and filters to read the legacy nine-piece seasonal snapshot. Catalog prices use 1 USD = 1 USDC; checkout calculates shipping and tax. Anonymous catalog reads are free.
name: wever_boutique-list-products
title: Rebecca Belle Boutique products
